verdict.rationale: SSH access with your own keys is a fair question for a GPU cloud, so the axis applies. The evidence only documents Kubernetes-mediated access: API tokens and kubeconfig for kubectl to CKS clusters on bare-metal nodes, plus Slurm-on-Kubernetes. Nothing in the pack mentions SSH key upload, direct SSH login to instances, or root-level control of the environment. kubectl access is an adjacent control and earns no credit for this story.
